question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

“Clever but dishonest manipulation to gain advantage.”
solution:
The correct answer is: **Chicanery**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Chicanery"** refers to the use of clever but dishonest manipulation or tricks to gain an advantage. (चालाकी या धूर्तता)

 
 
• **Example:** The politician was accused of chicanery when he misled the public about his intentions.
 
 
 
• **"Deception"** is the act of causing someone to believe something that is not true, typically to gain a personal advantage. (धोखा)
 
 
• **Example:** His deception was revealed when the truth about the fraud came out.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Chicanery" is the correct word for clever but dishonest manipulation to gain an advantage.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Chicanery**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Negotiation** (सौदेबाजी): A discussion aimed at reaching an agreement.

 
 
• **Example:** The two companies are in negotiation over a potential merger.
 
 
 
• **Deception** (धोखा): The act of misleading or tricking someone.
 
 
• **Example:** His deception was uncovered during the investigation.
 
 
 
• **Mediation** (मध्यस्थता): The act of intervening in a dispute to resolve it.
 
 
• **Example:** The mediator helped the two parties come to a peaceful resolution.
